headline: DNS fails: 10.77.0.53 does not answer DNS queries.

findings.message: No reply from DNS server 10.77.0.53: the query for app.silent.lab timed out.
findings.remedy: The DNS server never replied. Check it is running and that UDP and TCP port 53 are allowed between you and it; try another resolver to confirm.
